terms.grammar: fixed phrase, used on its own
terms.comment: Literally “said and done”: the deed follows the word at once.

terms.gloss: quicker than it can be said, in a flash
terms.grammar: ablative of comparison: “quicker than the word”
evidence: Verg. A. 1.142: sīc ait, et dictō citius tumida aequora plācat (Lewis & Short)

sources: Lewis & Short: dico
Lewis & Short: cito
